Application Data.NAME: ABC Windows & Doors, Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ABC Windows & Doors, Inc. provides professional installation and sales of residential doors and windows, ensuring all installation work is conducted by trained and certified personnel. Our operations include careful assessment of each installation site, adherence to industry safety standards, and the use of licensed subcontractors with their own liability insurance when necessary. We prioritize quality control and customer satisfaction, offering services such as consultation, custom measurements, and follow-up inspections to maintain superior installation quality. Additionally, we adhere strictly to regulations prohibiting the use of lead-containing materials in our products, ensuring compliance and safety for our clients.
